diagnosis.balancing_counter_risk: Change one proposal dimension per cohort and retain a control variant.
diagnosis.corrective_action: Run a controlled proposal-variant test with stronger problem framing and a bounded proof artifact.
diagnosis.global_impact: The system cannot learn commercial fit from silence alone.
diagnosis.higher_order_lesson: When the world remains silent, change the signal before increasing the volume.
diagnosis.local_impact: Current proposals do not open conversations.
diagnosis.principal_weakness: Verified submissions are not generating replies.
diagnosis.regression_risk: Changing several variables at once would destroy attribution.
diagnosis.root_cause_hypothesis: Targeting, timing, proof, pricing or proposal framing is failing to create enough relevance and trust.
diagnosis.strategic_impact: Repeated submission without adaptation wastes scarce opportunities.
diagnosis.success_metric: A verified reply rate above 0% in the next five comparable submissions.
diagnosis.systemic_impact: The feedback loop receives no customer signal.
diagnosis.uncertainty: Platform visibility and client inactivity may also contribute.
